title: Page 53
transc:
235 pm  Fort Monroe Jany 23d 1865
2 pm for BrGen D H Rucker Q Mr Washn .
I send today the El cid and Ranger .
the Cassandria is just here and will be sent as soon as
discharged ---- R C. Webster Col & Q Mr


245 pm  Baltimore Jany 23d 1865
2pm 23d CA Dana I have your advices with Col 
P's reports . one Regt the twenty eighth Mich arrived
yesterday am at Benwood and was at once
forwarded . In consequence of the storm the wires
are working badly to Wheeling and we have not advices
of further arrivals at the river . We judge how ever 
by our information from Cincinnati and Columbus that troops must
now be arriving at Benwood and loading rapidly .
the weather is very bad raining sleeting and snowing I
have however ordered large forces upon the track over the 
whole line who are working energetically to insure successful results
at nine am yesterday I ordered suspension of all
business except military and RR upon the telegraph lines between
Wheeling Parkersburg and Balt. so as to
aid in securing prompt communications . Every possible
precaution has been taken in view of the difficulties of the weather
and the season to insure safety and success J. W Garrett
